description: Pretrained weights for BanditRouter v2 with Virtual Anchors. Maps model archetypes to initial theta weights providing 'Initial Intuition' while maintaining 'High Plasticity' (A = λI).

feature_structure.description: Feature vector structure (total 50 dims with PCA)
dims: handcrafted: 11 (code_heavy, json, length_log, list_density, instruction_density, flesch, questions, toxicity, has_code_block, latex_density, length_penalty)

reasoning_model.description: High-capability models (HLE > 0.15): claude-opus-4.5, gpt-5, o3, grok-4, sonnet-4.5, oss-120b, etc.
reasoning_model.rationale: Strong positive weights on hard features (coding, math, complexity). Negative bias requires prompt to prove it needs intelligence.

turbo_model.description: Fast/cheap models (HLE < 0.10): gpt-4o, haiku-4.5, llama-3.1-70b, ministral-8b, gemma-3, etc.
turbo_model.rationale: Negative weights on hard features to avoid selecting cheap model for complex tasks. Positive bias wins by default for simple prompts.

usage_notes: The loader in _load_zero_shot_priors maps each model to an archetype based on HLE score:
These weights assume complexity_score and anchor similarities are normalized to [0,1].
The bandit learns quickly from user feedback, so these are just starting points.
